selectedBehaviorFindings:
## Python/client behavior: 3640684 baseline → supplied 3572727 target

Analysis used preserved Windows CPython **3.12**, matching both archives' `cb0d0d0a` bytecode magic, in a new disposable Wine prefix. Only archive data was unmarshaled/disassembled; neither client's code was imported or executed. Source `member:line` citations below use embedded bytecode source lines.

### Counts and method

| Measure | 3640684 baseline | 3572727 target |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| ZIP entries (including duplicate names) | 11,684 | 11,665 |
| Unique Python member names | 11,679 | 11,660 |
| Unique `frontier/` members | 1,628 | 1,616 |

Target adds **23** unique members and removes **42**; Frontier contributes 14 additions and 26 removals. All 11,637 shared member byte strings differ, but **11,360 have identical normalized code**, leaving **277 shared members with code/constant/signature differences**, of which 144 are under `frontier/`. Normalization removes pyc header, source filename, first line and line-table metadata while retaining bytecode, argument/local/free-variable definitions, constants (including nested code), flags, stack size and exception table. These counts identify code differences, not gameplay features or runtime compatibility.

Both archives contain five names twice: `const.pyc`, `eveLocalization/__init__.pyc`, and `more_itertools/{__init__,more,recipes}.pyc`. Duplicate occurrences within an archive contain different modules. The primary name-based inventory uses Python `ZipFile.read(name)`'s final entry. Each corresponding duplicate occurrence was also compared independently: **all ten occurrence pairs are normalized-code identical across builds**. Thus duplicate resolution does not hide a semantic change in this comparison.

Fingerprints:

- Baseline `code.ccp`: `2f43f4b8d34632b5d5fdc7b58af93364f606bd9ba67fcada588565ee0628122c`.
- Target `code.ccp`: `eee139e55d95d75e897eb944c8045fb9ee1ef1b86a8672c2f453e1fffcde9f89`.

### Verified workflow differences

| Area | Actual target difference from 3640684 | Implication for the current temporary profile |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Flight inputs | Removes `flight_latency`, `flight_latency_tracing`, `main_booster`, `rcs_driver`, `rcs_layout`, `rcs_motion`, `speed_ramp`, `span_sink` and Creation `rcs/*` modules. `navigation/const.pyc:8` replaces ramp rate `0.5` and wheel step `0.02` with `SPEED_FRACTION_STEP = 0.25`. Target integration has `_on_decrease_speed_executed:1049` and `_on_increase_speed_executed:1062`; removes speed-ramp/throttler machinery. | Client speed adjustment and native prediction/visuals need exact-build acceptance; do not carry over 3640684 latency/RCS assumptions. This does **not** remove pitch-rate/roll/brake/heading RPCs. |
| Default controls and command binding | Target `navigation/client/beta.pyc:49–54` sets default `InputScheme.A`; baseline supplies `_default_input_scheme` which selects using user ID parity. Removes held-direction/saved-shortcut/hold-loop/step-accumulator/wheel-gesture helpers. | Existing saved bindings and input adapters need a separate target check. Default input scheme changed; `frontier/beta.pyc` itself is normalized-code identical. |
| Active scanning controls/errors | Removes scanner command/const/keyboard-scan-angle modules. `hud/scanner/state.pyc:359` uses Ctrl+mouse wheel; target overlay labels it `CTRL-SCROLL` / `Adjust Scan Angle` (`overlay.pyc:25`). `ScanFailureReason` loses `MODULE_BUSY` and `MODULE_OFFLINE`, and service error conversion loses these explicit cases. Reticle fallback text changes `CAPACITOR LOW` → `ENERGY LOW`. | Target has the scanning RPC, but keyboard shortcuts/error presentation differ. Validate server rejection UX and control hints with this client. |
| Composite mining resync | Keeps `GetCompositeRecipe` (`_fetch_recipe:52`), `GetCompositeMinedSet` (`_fetch_mined_set:1121`) and `OnCompositeVoxelMined`; their leaf code is unchanged. Target removes `OnCompositeMinedSetChanged` subscription/handler and removes explicit `get_grid`/`replay_mined`/`apply_mined_blob` collision replay from `_reconcile_mined_set:1145`; it still decompresses bits and applies per-cell visual updates. Common helper module loses `trim_to_voxels`, `label_chunks`, `find_debris`, `only_debris_left`. | Incremental voxel mining remains present. Bulk mined-set rebuild notices and reconnect collision replay need targeted acceptance; do not claim that visual bit replay proves native collision consistency. |
| Tractor pickup UI | Adds `hud/bracket/ui/scoopable_bracket.pyc`, with range opacity, depth reveal ordering and entry animation. `ScoopChannelController.begin:254` / `_send_cancel:338` and the entire `CRRegolith` module are normalized-code identical. | `BeginScoop`, `CancelScoop` and `oreUnits` retain the same client contract; the added module is presentation code and alone creates no new server requirement. |
| Exploration detail lifecycle | Entire exploration messenger, UniverseDelta generated module, and schema metadata are normalized-code identical; **Universe schema remains 14**. Target `ResolvedSystemSvc.ensure_system_hydrated:784` lacks baseline `_detail_refused` cache and known/current-system guard. `wait_until_system_known:554` also lacks refusal-grace handling. The target lacks baseline `cfg_universe_shim.install_universe_location_guard` and the moon-specific orbit wrapper. | Keep the exact existing gateway/FlatBuffer shapes but expect broader or repeated detail fetches. Server disclosure policy must remain authoritative. Test refusal/retry/unknown-location handling and moon statistics. Full native map behavior remains untested. |
| Magnetic docking | Core target `get_capabilities:247`, `_manual_dock_to:425`, `_restore_dock_from_server:1029`, and `refuel_pane._handle_add_fuel:90` are normalized-code identical to baseline. Changed docking UI removes guide/service marker/button machinery and relocates undock actions. | Preserve existing docking/refuel server contracts; review the target UI adapters and keyboard/controller presentation separately. |
| Firing/aim convergence | Target `_find_fitted_skill_shot_module_ids:225` defaults to the **first** fitted single-shot module (`[:1]`), whereas baseline collects every fitted single-shot module when none is focused. Auto-cannon target uses a single toggle boolean instead of baseline per-module auto-fire IDs. `aimed_action/convergence.pyc` adds `MIN_ACCEPT_RANGE_METERS = 300.0` and applies it in guard/report paths; held-beam failure text becomes `ENERGY LOW`. | Multiple-weapon firing and close-range convergence differ in the client. Verify actual target selection, HUD toggle and hit reports; the constant is not a proven server minimum firing range. |
| Session/status recovery | Target `status_effect/client/service.pyc` removes `OnSessionReset` and `OnSessionChanged` handlers found in baseline; no claim that the entire status-effect system is absent. | Reconnect/character change status synchronization should be exercised. |
| Loot CRData extension | Target `CRLootContainer` drops `spawnCapacity`, `spawnDescription`, `spawnGraphicID`, `spawnHitpoints` properties present in baseline. | Review custom spawn-container/CRData and rendering adapters; native serialization acceptance is separate from Python property presence. |
| Demo/prototype branch | Adds arena population, demo-mode UI, gamepad focus, guide command, kill counter, scenario rules, demo character creation and a race-track prototype. Target `demotool/client/commands.pyc:_run_slash:69` / `begin_server_scenario:93` / `run_server_step:99` use remote **`demoToolStepRunner`** methods `run_scenario_step` / `begin_scenario`; target `demotool/const.pyc` adds `ROLE_DEMO`/role and developer-system checks. | These are concrete demo-tool branch dependencies. Their packaging does not establish ordinary player enablement; keep privileged scenario services separate from normal gameplay support. |

### Unchanged contracts specifically verified

Target Macho version remains **489** (`eve/common/script/net/eveMachoNetVersion.pyc:7`), with normalized-code equality. In `navigation/client/integration.pyc`, the exact leaf code for `_handle_pitch_rate_request:623`, `_handle_roll_rate_request:678`, `_handle_brake_request:690`, `_handle_heading_request:702` remains equal; calls still target `CmdSetPitchRate`, `CmdSetRollRate`, `CmdSetBrakeFraction`, `CmdSetHeading`. No handshake or native Destiny compatibility claim follows solely from Macho equality.

The target retains schema-14 `UniverseDelta`, exploration messenger, scoop/regolith, recipe fetch and per-voxel notices as above. `frontier/beta.pyc` has no code or flag changes. HUD setting module drops `threat_corner_brackets`; compass adds session `multi_star_enabled` default true while `compass_strip_enabled` remains false. These client defaults do not prove runtime configuration enablement.

### Reproducible local evidence

- `bytecode_compare.py`: exact comparison/disassembly worker (requires CPython 3.12).
- `bytecode_run.py`: local preserved-runtime launcher using isolated disposable Wine prefix, read-only client/runtime grants and an output-only write grant. Requires working Bottles Flatpak outside the restrictive command sandbox.
- `bytecode-inventory.json`: counts, all additions/removals/changed members, archive hashes, duplicate-occurrence hashes and equality.
- `bytecode-symbol-changes.json`: changed/added symbols with source lines, names, strings and literals.
- `bytecode-preserved-contracts.json`: exact equality checks on the selected leaf methods and contract modules.
- `bytecode-selected-dis.txt`: focused CPython 3.12 disassembly supporting the specific differences above.
- `bytecode-frontier-dis.txt`: complete disassembly of changed Frontier modules and selected related modules.
